headline: Charleston lead a three-way race at the top
dek: Charleston have won four straight since their only conference defeat, at home to Davis & Elkins, and lead the table by two points. Davis & Elkins have since lost at home to Concord, who sit three points off the top with a match in hand and Charleston still to visit them.
displaced_by: Davis & Elkins lost at home to Concord, ending their unbeaten run; Charleston now top the table

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston have scored more goals than West Liberty and Wheeling together, and fifteen different players have shared their forty-three; the scoring is spread, not carried.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Concord have conceded seven goals in thirteen matches and won nine of them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan are without a win after thirteen matches, with three draws and ten defeats, and have conceded forty-three goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Frank Stare has seven goals and four assists for Frostburg State from thirty shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hugo Fauli has seven assists and three goals for Davis & Elkins.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shai'ya Fitzgerald has made forty-nine saves for West Liberty and conceded thirteen goals.

last_match.line: Charleston have won every conference match since losing at home to Davis & Elkins; Shawnee State have lost every match they have played in October.

next_match.line: A win would draw Concord level on points with Charleston; Salem lost the first meeting on their own ground.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
